explication: This repository is a Flipper Zero firmware port for ESP32 boards, combining device applications and services with hardware-backed storage. A typical user selects an application, interacts with its UI, and gets a device or file operation. The supplied tree shows several application families and storage integrations, but the sampled source is mostly storage code; links between unsampled application internals and hardware are therefore omitted. The README excerpt documents broader wireless capabilities whose implementation paths are not present in this tree.
